title: Administrator
company: Encon Staffing Associates Ltd - Agency - Temporary
description:
Encon Staffing is recruiting a Compliance Administrator for a supported housing organisation in Bradford. The organisation provides accommodation alongside care, support or supervision, helping people live as independently as possible.

You ll join a busy Compliance and Property Team, giving admin support to the Compliance Manager and Property Coordinator. Your work will help make sure every property used for residents meets statutory compliance and health and safety requirements.

What you ll be doing
- Logging repairs reported by support staff and residents, raising work orders and following them through to completion
- Liaising with repairs and compliance contractors, and chasing compliance documents, completed work orders, overdue jobs and invoices
- Checking and verifying documents before approving them or escalating them where needed
- Asking contractors for updated compliance certificates before they expire, and urgently following up any that have lapsed
- Keeping records accurate and up to date on internal systems, including CAFM and databases
- Supporting the onboarding and offboarding of properties so they stay compliant with H&S legislation and government guidance
- Managing key coordination across the property portfolio and acting as the central point of contact for keys
- Following access processes, including issuing, recording and keeping appointment letters
- Creating contracts, SLAs and other required documents for service users and providers
- Spotting non-compliance and giving providers support and guidance to resolve it
- Producing accurate management information and performance reports on time
- Handling enquiries from the local council, residents, staff and providers in person, by phone and by email
- Supporting the scheduling of inspectors calendars
- Working with the Quality Assurance, Benefits and Contract Performance teams as needed
- Reviewing contractor compliance and acting where standards or contract terms aren t being met
- Taking appropriate action on building notices, planning applications and housing standards referrals

What we re looking for
- Previous experience in an admin role, ideally in compliance, property, housing or facilities management
- Confidence using IT systems such as Excel, Word, CAFM systems and databases
- Strong organisational skills and a flexible approach to work
- Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to chase contractors and handle queries professionally
- High attention to detail and accuracy when checking documents and records
- A proactive problem-solver who understands how issues affect the wider operation
- Ability to work to targets and SLAs as part of a high-performing team
- Knowledge of property compliance or H&S legislation (desirable)

Why apply?
- Rewarding work in an organisation that supports people to live independently
- Stable office-based hours with no weekends
- A collaborative team focused on continuous improvement
- Opportunities for training and professional development

description:

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Location: Bradford, West Yorkshire, BD4.
Salary: £25,500 starting salary.
Working Hours: Thursday Monday. Flexible hours between 8am 6pm on Thursday, Friday and Monday with 7am 3pm working hours on Saturday and Sunday
Working Pattern: Office-based

The Opportunity

Hawk 3 Talent Solutions is recruiting on behalf of a growing ecommerce client for proactive, adaptable and customer-focused Customer Service Advisors to join their busy team in Bradford.

Working within a fast-paced and continually evolving online retail environment, you will play an important role in delivering excellent customer service, resolving customer enquiries and ensuring a positive customer experience from order placement through to delivery and aftercare.

This is a varied role that will suit someone who is comfortable responding to changing priorities, identifying potential issues and working collaboratively with colleagues across the business. You will be responsible for managing customer queries relating to orders, deliveries, returns, refunds, product information and aftersales support, taking ownership of issues and working towards effective resolutions.

Key Responsibilities
- Respond to customer enquiries across various channels, providing a professional, helpful and timely service.
- Manage customer queries relating to orders, deliveries, returns, refunds, product information and aftersales support.
- Take ownership of customer issues, working proactively to investigate and resolve queries wherever possible.
- Identify, highlight and report recurring issues, system errors, process gaps and potential problems that could affect the customer experience or wider business.
- Adapt quickly to changing workloads, business priorities, systems and processes within a fast-paced ecommerce environment.
- Liaise effectively with other departments, particularly Operations, Ecommerce and Warehouse, to investigate and resolve customer issues.
- Maintain accurate customer records, ensuring all relevant information is recorded and communicated appropriately.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer service processes, operational efficiency and the overall customer experience.
- Provide feedback and suggestions to support continuous improvement across the customer service function.
- Balance working independently and using initiative with contributing positively to the wider team.
- Provide consistent customer service and support during weekend trading hours.
- Manage competing priorities effectively, ensuring customer enquiries are dealt with promptly and professionally.

Experience Required
- Previous experience in a customer service or customer-facing role.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and effectively with customers and colleagues.
- A flexible and adaptable approach, with the ability to respond positively to changing priorities.
- Experience working in a fast-paced environment, ideally within online retail, ecommerce or a similar customer-focused operation.
- Good problem-solving skills and the ability to use initiative when investigating and resolving customer issues.
- Excellent attention to detail, with the confidence to identify, flag and report errors, inconsistencies and potential problems.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage individual responsibilities independently.
- A positive, practical and proactive attitude, with a willingness to get involved and support the wider team.
- The ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across different departments.
- Basic Microsoft Excel skills would be advantageous.
- Familiarity with ecommerce platforms and online retail operations would be beneficial.
- Experience using customer service or order management systems such as eDesk and Linnworks would be advantageous.

Applications are welcomed from candidates who can demonstrate strong customer service skills, a proactive approach to problem-solving and a genuine willingness to learn. Experience within the furniture or ecommerce industry would be beneficial but is not essential for someone with the right attitude and transferable skills.

Weekend working is an essential requirement of the role.

title: Housing Support Coordinator
description:
Housing Support Coordinator

Location: Based across Bradford and Keighley

Salary: SCP 1 to 12, £26,228 to £27,844, based on experience.

Contract: Permanent, 37 hours per week

Working in partnership, Waythrough and The Bridge Project deliver the Bradford Temporary Accommodation Service on behalf of Bradford Metropolitan District Council, providing safe, supportive, and temporary accommodation for women who present as homeless to the Local Authority.

As a Housing Support Coordinator, you will play a key role in empowering women to achieve greater stability, independence, and positive outcomes. The service supports women who have experienced homelessness and may also have a history of offending, vulnerabilities, complex support needs, or be at risk of involvement with the criminal justice system.

Based across Bradford and Keighley, you will work alongside individuals living in temporary accommodation, providing person-centred support tailored to their unique circumstances. Your role will involve helping women to address housing issues, overcome barriers to independence, and access the services and opportunities they need to rebuild their lives.

This is a rewarding opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of women who have experienced homelessness and significant adversity. The role requires a flexible, compassionate, and trauma-informed approach, balancing housing management responsibilities with high-quality support delivery.

Successful candidates will be committed to working collaboratively with partners, advocating for the needs of service users, and helping individuals move towards greater independence, stability, and social inclusion. Through building positive relationships and providing practical, person-centred support, you will contribute to creating lasting change for some of the most vulnerable women within our communities.

Please note that this position is delivered on a rolling rota framework and requires the successful candidate to work a range of shift patterns, including early shifts, to ensure continuous service provision. Depending on operational requirements, shifts may also include evenings, weekends, and public holidays. The nature of the role demands a flexible and responsive approach, ensuring that residents receive timely support, safeguarding interventions, and housing management assistance whenever needed.

A driving licence with access to a vehicle and fully comprehensive business insurance is essential for this role. A willingness to undergo an enhanced DBS check is also a requirement of the post (the results of which would not necessarily exclude applicants from consideration).

Joining The Bridge Project means becoming part of a team that values you, your wellbeing, your growth, and your future. Alongside a rewarding career, you ll enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive:
- Competitive salary that reflects your skills and contribution
- 32 days of annual leave to rest, recharge, and enjoy life outside work
- 5% employer pension contribution to support your long term financial security
- A dedicated Learning & Development programme to help you grow and progress
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme offering confidential advice whenever you need it
- Death in service benefit worth three times your salary for added peace of mind
- Refer a friend bonus of £500 when you help us bring great people on board
- Two hours of monthly wellbeing time to pause, connect, and reset with your team
- A programme of mindfulness activities to boost focus on overall wellbeing
- Access to a Blue Light Card, giving you discounts across hundreds of retailers, restaurants, and leisure brands.

The Bridge Project is proud to be a Mindful Employer, championing a workplace where wellbeing truly matters.

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and adults and to creating safe, inclusive services. All staff are expected to share this commitment

title: HR & Payroll Administrator
company: Driver Hire Group Services Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
HR & Payroll Administrator

Bradford-based (hybrid working, typically 2-3 days per week in the office)

25 hours per week, worked across 5 days

£19,286 - £20,714 per annum (FTE £27,000 - £29,000)

The best HR teams get the basics right.

Contracts issued when they should be. New starters feel welcomed and prepared. Payroll runs smoothly. Records are accurate. Managers and their teams get the support they need when they need it. Hundreds of small things done well, every day.

We re looking for an HR & Payroll Administrator to help us support colleagues across the UK and Australia, while ensuring processes behind the scenes run smoothly, accurately and efficiently.

About the role

You ll get involved with every aspect of the employee lifecycle. Some days you'll be helping managers recruit new members of their team, from placing adverts and coordinating applications through to preparing everything a new starter needs before their first day. Others might involve drafting HR documentation or helping collate information for payroll.

Alongside that, you ll be one of the first points of contact for HR queries from colleagues across the business. Sometimes you ll be able to resolve these yourself; other times you ll work with the rest of the team to make sure the query gets to the person best placed to help. As part of a three-person HR team, you'll gain broad experience across HR rather than specialising in a single area, giving you exposure to almost every stage of the employee lifecycle.

About you

We're looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, pays attention to detail and gets genuine satisfaction from a job well done.

You ll enjoy this role if you:
- Have experience working in an HR environment and understand the fundamentals of HR administration and the employee lifecycle
- Take pride in accuracy and organisation, and enjoy bringing structure to a busy environment.
- Accept the responsibility of being trusted with confidential information
- Like solving problems and finding ways to improve how things work.
- Are keen to learn. Previous payroll experience isn't essential and neither is experience of supporting teams internationally. We'll help you develop both, including exposure to our Australian operations and the opportunity to learn about a different employment environment.

About us

In the HR team, everyone has their own area of responsibility and the autonomy the take ownership of their work. At the same time, we work closely together, share knowledge and step in to support each other when needed. We re looking for someone who enjoys both the accountability that comes with ownership and the collaboration that comes from being part of a team.

We work in a hybrid way, with colleagues typically spending 2-3 days per week in our Bradford office. The role is 25 hours per week, worked across five days, with flexibility around start and finish times to be agreed with the successful candidate.

Why join Driver Hire?

Driver Hire is the UK's largest specialist logistics recruiter, with a network of offices across the UK and operations in Australia. We've built our reputation by helping people and businesses find the right opportunities and support when they need it.

We offer a competitive salary, pension, healthcare scheme, hybrid working, 33 days' holiday including bank holidays, free parking, quarterly social events, an extra day off for your birthday and a paid volunteering day each year.

Most importantly, you'll be joining a business that invests in its people. In our most recent employee survey, 96% of colleagues said they were proud or very proud to work for Driver Hire.

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and enthusiastic Office Administrator & Marketing Coordinator to support the smooth day to day running of the business.

This is a varied role combining general office administration, accounts support, staff training coordination, accreditation management, business development support and marketing activities.

The successful candidate will work closely with the company directors and wider team, helping to maintain operational efficiency, support business growth and promote the company's professional image.

Key Responsibilities

1. Office Administration
- Manage general day to day office administration and provide support across the business.
- Handle incoming telephone calls, emails and general correspondence.
- Maintain accurate company records, filing systems and documentation.

- Assist with processing purchase invoices, raising sales invoices and maintaining financial records.
- Support the monitoring of outstanding payments and supplier queries.

3. Staff Training & Compliance
- Maintain and regularly update the company training matrix.
- Monitor employee training requirements, qualifications and certification expiry dates.
- Organise and book training courses, refresher sessions and assessments in line with the training matrix.

- Track renewal dates and ensure applications and supporting documentation are submitted on time.

- Keep company policies, procedures and supporting compliance documentation up to date.
- Support accreditation audits, assessments and compliance reviews.
- Ensure the business maintains the certifications required to meet client and industry standards.

- Assist company directors in identifying and researching new B2 B tender and business development opportunities.
- Monitor relevant tender portals and highlight suitable opportunities to the directors.
- Support the preparation, coordination and submission of tender documentation, PQQs and supporting information.
- Maintain an organised library of company information, accreditations, case studies and documents for tender submissions.
- Track tender deadlines and assist in ensuring submissions are completed accurately and on time.
- Work with directors to develop professional client proposals and business development materials.

6. Marketing & Client Presentations
- Create professional PowerPoint presentations for client meetings, tender submissions and business development opportunities.
- Assist with producing company brochures, capability statements, case studies and other marketing materials.
- Ensure marketing materials reflect the company's branding, services and values.
- Work with directors to promote the company's achievements, projects and capabilities.
- Support the development of consistent and professional external communications.

7. LinkedIn & Social Media
- Create and publish a minimum of one engaging company LinkedIn post per week.
- Develop content highlighting company projects, achievements, accreditations, training, team updates and industry news.
- Maintain a consistent and professional company presence on LinkedIn.
- Liaise with colleagues and directors to gather photographs, project information and updates for social media content.
- Assist with growing brand awareness and engagement with potential clients and industry contacts.

Skills & Experience

Essential:
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Previous experience in an administrative or office support role.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.
- Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and prioritise deadlines.
- Confident working independently and supporting senior management.
- A proactive, flexible and positive approach to work.
- Professional and confident when communicating with clients, suppliers and colleagues.

Desirable:
- Experience supporting an accounts or finance department.
- Experience managing staff training records, compliance documentation or accreditations.
- Familiarity with B2 B tender portals and tender submission processes.
- Experience creating business presentations and marketing materials.
- Knowledge of LinkedIn company page management and content creation.
- Experience using Canva or other design software.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured against:
- Office Administration: Efficient completion of administrative tasks and accurate record keeping.
- Accounts Support: Timely processing of paperwork and effective assistance to the accounts team.
- Training Compliance: Training matrix kept current, with refresher training booked ahead of expiry dates.
- Accreditations: 100% of required company accreditations maintained and renewed before expiry.
- Tender Support: Relevant B2 B opportunities regularly identified, tracked and supported within submission deadlines.
- Marketing Materials: High-quality, professional client presentations and business development documentation produced on time.
- LinkedIn Activity: A minimum of one relevant, professional LinkedIn post published each week.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:
- Highly organised and detail oriented.
- Self-motivated, reliable and able to take ownership of responsibilities.
- Creative and confident in producing professional marketing content.
- Comfortable working directly with company directors.
- Able to manage competing priorities in a busy office environment.
- Keen to learn, develop new skills and contribute to the growth of the business.

What We Offer

- The opportunity to work closely with the directors and contribute to business growth.
- Opportunities for professional development and additional training.
- A supportive and collaborative working environment.
- The opportunity to take ownership of key administrative, compliance and marketing activities.

Overall Objective

To provide reliable and proactive administrative support across the business, ensuring
office operations run efficiently, training and accreditations remain compliant, and the
directors are effectively supported with tender opportunities, client presentations and
marketing activities.

Are you passionate about making a difference to the lives of those who need it most? If so, we have a rewarding opportunity and would love to hear from you!

New Vision Bradford is a partnership between the Bridge Project, Create Strength Group, Project 6 and Waythrough. Under this umbrella, the partnership delivers an adult drug and alcohol service for the Bradford and Craven District, aiming to help people tackle the use of alcohol and drugs and reduce risk taking behaviours through dedicated prevention, intervention, and support.

The Bridge Project is excited to be recruiting a full-time Rough Sleeper Recovery Coordinator, joining the New Vision Bradford partnership to make a real impact in people s lives. It is essential that the successful applicant can travel across the district, getting to different locations so a full driving licence, access to a vehicle and business insurance for work purposes is an essential requirement.

The role will work as part of the multi-disciplinary team delivering high-quality drug and alcohol treatment by supporting service users from point of entry into the service and throughout their treatment and recovery journey. Outreach is a key component of the role to connect with individuals rough sleeping or at risk of rough sleeping with substance use concerns and other unmet needs, which may include mental or physical health, relationships, finances or criminal justice involvement.

You will play a crucial role acting as the main care coordinator for an assigned group of service users, coordinating tailor made packages of care and providing vital support, including comprehensive assessments, recovery planning, one to one key work, recognised psychosocial interventions and harm minimisation.

Everything we do aims to positively impact the lives of rough sleepers or those at risk of rough sleeping. In order to be considered for this role you will need 2 years full-time experience of working with people with alcohol and/or drug problems and/or people with complex and multiple needs within a 4-year period as well as being able to demonstrate experience of case management and delivering care coordination in drug and alcohol or a directly related field.

We are looking for someone who is dedicated and passionate about supporting others to make change. You will be highly organised with excellent communication skills and able to manage your time effectively, working as part of the team with a co-operative approach to supporting colleagues to ensure a high-quality service is maintained, whilst applying your knowledge and understanding of drug and alcohol issues.

There is an element of flexibility around working hours required by the postholder. A willingness to undergo an enhanced DBS check is also a requirement of the post (the results of which would not necessarily exclude applicants from consideration).

- A dedicated Learning & Development programme to help you grow and progress
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme offering confidential advice whenever you need it

- Refer a friend bonus of £500 when you help us bring great people on board
- Two hours of monthly wellbeing time to pause, connect, and reset with your team
- A programme of mindfulness activities to boost focus on overall wellbeing
- Access to a Blue Light Card, giving you discounts across hundreds of retailers, restaurants, and leisure brands.

The Bridge Project is proud to be a Mindful Employer, championing a workplace where wellbeing truly matters.

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and adults and to creating safe, inclusive services. All staff are expected to share this commitment.

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for The Bridge Project, please click apply to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

title: Social Media & Content Creator
description:
Do you see a dog with a toothbrush and immediately think "that's a Reel"? We're looking for a creative, hands-on content creator to own our UK organic social channels, from the first idea to the final post.

Social Media & Content Creator, UK

Swedencare UK
Location: Bradford, West Yorkshire Office Based
- £28,000-30,000
- Full-time, permanent

About Us

Swedencare is an international animal health company behind brands including ProDen PlaqueOff, NaturVet By Swedencare and Nutriscience. Our Global Marketing team sets the brand strategy and campaign concepts. We want someone in the UK who can take those, add their own ideas, and turn them into content that UK pet owners stop scrolling for, and that turns their attention into sales.

What you'll do
- Plan and run the UK organic social calendar across Instagram, Facebook and other relevant platforms
- Shoot, edit and design your own content: short-form video, photography, graphics, carousels and captions
- Create content for the full funnel, from brand awareness to conversion-focused posts that drive clicks and sales
- Turn global campaigns and toolkits into content that feels local, and build on existing assets
- Spot UK trends, seasonal moments and cultural opportunities before they peak
- Write scroll-stopping copy with strong hooks and clear calls to action
- Publish, manage the community and report on what's working, then do more of it
- Build strong relationships with other established content creators & influencers.
- Attend the annual Crufts show, as part of networking with fellow influencers & creators.

What you'll bring
- A portfolio of social content you've created yourself, from concept to finished post
- Confident skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects and Figma
- A strong feel for platform formats, trends and algorithms
- An understanding of both brand-building and conversion-focused content, and when to use each
- Sharp, on-brand copywriting in English
- The confidence to work independently and bring ideas without waiting for a brief
- A habit of checking the numbers, including clicks and conversions, and using them to improve

Bonus points for
- Experience in pet care, FMCG or consumer brands
- Working with UGC, influencers or creators
- A basic grasp of paid social and social commerce
- Experience with international brands or global marketing teams

You don't need years of strategy experience. We care more about creativity, initiative and production skills.

How to apply

If you have the skills and experience required for this Social Media & Content Creator position based in Bradford, click "apply" today and check your inbox for an email providing more information on how to tailor your application and provide a cover letter or any supporting documents.

No agencies please.

Other suitable skills and experience include: Social Media Executive, Content Creator, Digital Content Executive, Social Media Manager, Content Marketing Executive, Social Media Content Creator, Digital Marketing Executive, Video Content Creator, Social Media Coordinator.

title: Receptionist
description: As a key member of the Patient Services team you will be responsible for providing an efficient reception function that includes some specific administration duties. To ensure the front of house service of meeting and greeting is welcoming and portrays our standards of high quality, professional and patient-focused care. To ensure a high focus on customer satisfaction by dealing with queries in a speedy and accurate manner, applying emotionally conscious responses as relevant. To deal with patients and visitors in a courteous manner, using your skills to ensure matters are dealt with efficiently; providing effective management to patient demand, and reducing undue delay or queues at the front desk/phones To work to protocols with regard booking appointments, repeat prescriptions, ordering of patient transport including emergency ambulances and all other duties as explained to you by the Patient Services Manager. To deal with general queries and liaise effectively with clinicians and other staff as required. To support clinicians during their clinics by dealing with their queries and tasks as requested. This may be the need for some stock in their rooms, following up an appointment with the hospital, or other ad hoc requests. To provide chaperoning service where requested by the clinician and/or patient. To ensure patient confidentiality, including the use of the computer system and visibility of the screen as well as the transfer of written and verbal communication. To converse with patients and visitors by speaking clearly, precisely and with confidence both over the phone and face-to-face at the desk. To signpost patients to the most appropriate service.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Kensington Partnership is seeking a friendly, professional and organised Medical Receptionist to join our busy GP practice team. The successful candidate will provide efficient reception and administrative support, ensuring patients receive a welcoming and professional service. Excellent communication, IT and organisational skills are essential, along with the ability to work under pressure, use initiative and work effectively as part of a team. Previous NHS, GP reception or SystmOne experience is desirable, but full training will be provided. Flexibility to cover staff absences and work across practice sites where required is also desirable. Recruitment Process Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a pre-interview information session on Thursday, 19 November 2026, from 1:00 pm to 3:00 pm , to gain a better understanding of the role and its expectations. Those who remain interested will be invited to a formal interview at a later date. You will join a supportive, forward-thinking team, delivering professional and compassionate patient services within a busy primary care environment. With most incoming calls managed through our AI system, the role primarily involves handling face-to-face enquiries, supporting AI-assisted triage and providing administrative support. Responsibilities include reviewing and processing patient requests, maintaining accurate records, directing enquiries to appropriate teams and escalating clinical concerns in accordance with practice procedures. Occasional telephone duties may also be required. A courteous, confidential and patient-centred approach is essential at all times. Reception and Patient Services Welcome patients and manage face-to-face enquiries professionally and courteously. Handle calls transferred by the AI telephone system requiring receptionist assistance. Support AI-assisted triage by reviewing and processing patient requests in line with practice procedures. Book appointments following triage outcomes and provide appropriate care navigation. Signpost patients to relevant services and escalate urgent or complex concerns to the clinical team. Administration and Practice Support Maintain accurate patient records using SystmOne and other practice systems. Process correspondence, home visit requests, ambulance transport and interpreter bookings. Handle payments, receipts, deliveries and general administrative duties. Provide day-to-day administrative support to GPs, clinical staff and colleagues. Communication and Teamwork Communicate professionally and compassionately with patients, carers, colleagues and external agencies. Work collaboratively and flexibly across practice sites as required. Support patients with additional communication or accessibility needs. Undertake chaperone duties when appropriately trained and authorised. Confidentiality and Information Governance Maintain strict confidentiality and access patient records only when authorised and necessary. Comply with UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and practice information governance policies. Promptly report suspected data breaches, security incidents or confidentiality concerns. General Responsibilities Assist with opening and securing practice premises when authorised. Maintain a safe, tidy and welcoming reception environment. Follow safeguarding, infection prevention, health and safety, and other practice policies. Complete mandatory training and undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the role.
